final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.wins) as avg_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId GROUP BY c.country), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.country, s1.avg_wins, s1.avg_wins - s2.overall_avg as diff FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s1.avg_wins > s2.overall_avg), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as avg_from_step3 FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.country, s3.avg_wins, s3.diff, s3.avg_wins - s4.avg_from_step3 as diff2 FROM step3 s3 CROSS JOIN step4 s4 WHERE s3.avg_wins > s4.avg_from_step3) SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as final_avg_wins, AVG(diff) as final_avg_diff, AVG(diff2) as final_avg_diff2 FROM step5
